title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia, received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The threat prompted school officials to place the school on lockdown out of an abundance of caution, and normal operations later resumed. In a letter to parents, school police said the latest incident followed a pattern seen in recent threats involving a masked phone number.

Gwinnett County Public Schools police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified in connection with the threats. The article does not say what specific steps will happen next beyond the ongoing investigation.
title_en: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown
